about: Lines the librarian has read and checked by hand. A path with a line replaces the tool's line; a path with null confirms the tool's line. index/tools/build_index.py marks these rows read_by librarian.

read..github/workflows/release.yml: CI: gates, numbers (dev bumps the last number, main the middle), tags, builds and deploys every release
read..gitignore: Python's standard ignore list plus the build output _site/
read.BRIEF-CORRECTIONS.md: where corrections to BRIEF.md go; at the pin it still says None yet: no correction was ever filed there
read.BRIEF.md: the editor's request of 29 October, as given and never edited: the site and the talk for hack::soho, IOActive London
read.CLAUDE.md: the rules every agent on the talk's team followed; the book's CLAUDE.md ports them rule for rule
read.README.md: what the repository is (the-ultimate-insider.presentation.sgit.ai), how to run it locally, how a release goes out
read.REALITY.md: what actually existed, kept by whoever shipped, one section per member; dev kept the file as a whole
read.run-website-locally.sh: build, gate and serve the site on localhost:8000
read.site.json: the site's name, URL, repository, tagline and navigation
read.version: the release number CI wrote; v0.2.0 at the pin
read.admin/build/agents.py: builds the team pages from team/<id>/ and checks each member's writes against its policy (agents.py check)
read.admin/build/lane.py: drains the editor's lane: notes the editor's pane sent, encrypted to the conductor's key, decrypted by the conductor
read.admin/build/lock.py: locks one part of the talk (the editor at 16:55 London): a frozen copy of everything that part's slides load, played from the copy
read.admin/notes/2026-10-29__first-agents-and: the conductor's first proposal of agents and schedule, corrected the same day after it read BRIEF.md; the original left below
read.admin/tools/pki-agent.README.md: where the pinned key tool came from, its hash, and how an agent makes its session key
read.admin/tools/pki-agent.mjs: the editor's key tool from pki.sgit.ai, pinned unmodified (one file, Node 18+); not read line by line on the day
read.admin/tools/vault_check.py: run before every vault commit: every file in the team's vaults is public, so it looks for keys and personal details
